user.title: Add a Pool IQ Hub device
user.description: Connects a Pool IQ Hub device (such as a controller, chlorinator or water filler) to Home Assistant. Each device has its own 12-character device ID, shown in the Pool IQ app. Add the integration once for each device. Enter the username and password supplied by Pool IQ Hub. Leave the backend host as it is.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Pool IQ backend.
error.invalid_auth: Login was rejected. Check the username and password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
